statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_watches (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
 label VARCHAR(200),
 is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 watch_seo BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 watch_content BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 watch_links BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 watch_html BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 content_selector VARCHAR(500),
 ignore_selectors JSONB,
 ignore_regexes JSONB,
 muted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 check_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT uq_web_watches_client_url UNIQUE (client_id, url),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_watches_source CHECK (source IN ('manual','bulk','sitemap','csv'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_watches_client_active ON web_watches (client_id, is_active)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_watches_check_requested ON web_watches (check_requested_at) WHERE check_requested_at IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_sweep_runs (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 run_date DATE NOT NULL,
 trigger VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduler',
 status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
 started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 watches_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 watches_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 watches_error INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 changes_found INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 notified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 notify_status VARCHAR(32),
 notify_error VARCHAR(500),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_sweep_runs_trigger CHECK (trigger IN ('scheduler','manual','api')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_sweep_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('running','done','partial','failed'))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_web_sweep_runs_scheduler_day ON web_sweep_runs (client_id, run_date) WHERE trigger = 'scheduler'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_sweep_runs_client_started ON web_sweep_runs (client_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_sweep_runs_started ON web_sweep_runs (started_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_snapshots (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 watch_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES web_watches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 run_id UUID REFERENCES web_sweep_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 content_hash VARCHAR(64),
 html_hash VARCHAR(64),
 status_code INTEGER,
 byte_size INTEGER,
 text_gz BYTEA,
 html_gz BYTEA,
 text_inline TEXT,
 is_pinned BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_snapshots_watch_captured ON web_snapshots (watch_id, captured_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_watch_state (
 watch_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES web_watches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 last_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_status_code INTEGER,
 last_final_url TEXT,
 last_error VARCHAR(500),
 consecutive_errors INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 hash_seo VARCHAR(64),
 hash_content VARCHAR(64),
 hash_links VARCHAR(64),
 hash_html VARCHAR(64),
 seo_json JSONB,
 links_json JSONB,
 needs_js_render BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 scope_missed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 checking_since TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_snapshot_id UUID REFERENCES web_snapshots(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_watch_state_client_changed ON web_watch_state (client_id, last_changed_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_run_errors (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 run_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES web_sweep_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 watch_id UUID REFERENCES web_watches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 message VARCHAR(500),
 status_code INTEGER,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_run_errors_run ON web_run_errors (run_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_changes (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 watch_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES web_watches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 run_id UUID REFERENCES web_sweep_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 snapshot_id UUID REFERENCES web_snapshots(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 prev_snapshot_id UUID REFERENCES web_snapshots(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 max_severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 acknowledged_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 acknowledged_by_label VARCHAR(120),
 acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 note TEXT,
 CONSTRAINT uq_web_changes_watch_run UNIQUE (watch_id, run_id),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_changes_max_severity CHECK (max_severity IN ('critical','warning','info'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_changes_client_detected ON web_changes (client_id, detected_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_changes_watch_detected ON web_changes (watch_id, detected_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_changes_pending ON web_changes (client_id, max_severity) WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_change_items (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 change_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES web_changes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 field VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 rule_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 before_val TEXT,
 after_val TEXT,
 detail JSONB,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_change_items_kind CHECK (kind IN ('seo','content','links','html','availability')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_change_items_severity CHECK (severity IN ('critical','warning','info'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_change_items_change ON web_change_items (change_id)

ALTER TABLE client_web_settings
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS digest_min_severity VARCHAR(16),
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_content_selector VARCHAR(500),
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_ignore_selectors JSONB,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_ignore_regexes JSONB,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_concurrency SMALLINT,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS request_timeout_s SMALLINT,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS crawl_delay_ms INTEGER,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sweep_weekdays JSONB,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sweep_skip_dates JSONB,
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sweep_summary_to_slack BOOLEAN
